articles.title: Israel's Likud Party Picks Its Team for a Super Important Election
articles.summary: Israel's ruling Likud party is choosing who gets to run in the next big election. Prime Minister Netanyahu gets to pick 8 spots himself, leaving only 15 up for grabs. The vote could decide the country's future.

articles.title: Trump's Team Has More Super-Rich People Than the Last Three Presidents Combined!
articles.summary: A new report says President Trump has appointed 57 people worth at least $100 million. That's more than four times the number under the last three presidents put together. Some are billionaires like Education Secretary Linda McMahon.

articles.title: Kushner Meets Netanyahu After Hamas Talks: Will the Gaza Ceasefire Move Forward?
articles.summary: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, met with Israeli PM Netanyahu about the Gaza ceasefire plan. Hamas says it agreed, but Israel wants Hamas to fully disarm first. The lives of 2 million Palestinians hang in the balance.
